title: EditorConfig Generator
description: Build an .editorconfig file — indentation, line endings, charset and per-language overrides.
howto: Set root, charset, indent style and line endings.

faqs.a: A standard that keeps coding styles consistent across editors — most editors read .editorconfig automatically.
Stops EditorConfig from looking for .editorconfig files in parent directories.
Sections like [*.{js,ts}] override the global rules for matching files.
Save as .editorconfig in your project root.
